statistical_scope: Strict preregistered corpus point estimates and falsification gate. Five positive holdout spans are not a population-wide confidence claim; deterministic scanner recall and false-positive coverage is reported separately.

protocol_revision.reason: Two public execution attempts aborted before completing an artifact or producing a score. The first exposed an impossible exact-no-op validation loop. The second exposed an isolated sentence-burstiness advisory incorrectly corroborating a soft silhouette advisory.
protocol_revision.scope: Runner and scorer evidence handling only: exact empty-finding no-ops bypass source-only rewrite diagnostics after preservation, change-coverage, and attribution gates; the scorer independently recomputes that eligibility. Silhouette corroboration now uses only structure findings that are themselves blocking.
protocol_revision.controls: No public model output was inspected beyond either abort error. Corpus, prompts, annotations, scanner, models, and metric thresholds are unchanged. Both repairs have focused regression coverage and independent adversarial SHIP reviews. The deterministic tune clean-short-circuit expectation was refrozen from 2 to 5 because three sources contain only the newly corrected advisory-plus-advisory combination. The public protocol is refrozen after execution failures, and retry 2 uses a fresh uncached run directory. The sealed holdback remains the unbiased final confirmation.
